cases.title: A pipe end 50 mm outside pit P8's opening is caught and moved onto the inside wall; a pipe end 150 mm outside stays a free end
cases.plan_item: UX-PIT-02 pit catch, outline plus 100 mm (daily card D02)
cases.expected: New pit P8 at 150000,-80000 (cover 19.000, three Esc). Near pipe from 160225,-79850 to 150275,-79850 (start moved from 160275 after run n28a5 so the pipe is exactly 10 m once the end is caught; the 10.05 m pipe opened a Grade mismatch question the robot cannot answer) (end 50 mm outside the 450 mm opening, inverts 18.000 / 17.900): CE says 'Pipe end moved to the inside wall of P8 (was 50 mm short of the wall).' and 'Flow: Open end -> P8', and the pipe box starts at x 150225. Far pipe from 160375,-80150 to 150375,-80150 (end 150 mm outside): no wall move, 'Flow: Open end -> Open end', the pipe box starts at x 150375. In all, three 'End is free' lines (the near pipe's east end, both ends of the far pipe).

not_automated: The exact boundary (an end 90 mm out caught, 110 mm out not) is not driven: the drawn wall line at 100 mm would sit within a few mm of those points. Codex can do the card's 90 / 110 pair by eye if wanted.
The pit's size is not set by the robot (the Pit tab cannot be selected); it is the remembered 450 x 450 (recorded).

cases.expected: With both switches on: the new pipe's start invert text IL 18.000 at P8 is moved by hand 5 mm down (it moves 5 mm); the SPOT LEVEL block 10EC5D is moved onto it as in R16; CDTIDYLABELS All then counts 'Placed by hand (left alone) 1', lists no 'start invert text would move' line, and after the Yes answer that text is still exactly where the hand put it (0 mm, within 0.5); the drawing holds the same number of objects.
